function.name: sports_ranking_get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is required.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the 2003 Mr. Basketball America and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA as the first overall pick in the 2003 draft and has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (2003–2010, 2014–2018), Miami Heat (2010–2014), and Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present). LeBron has won four NBA championships (2007, 2012, 2013, 2020), earned four NBA Most Valuable Player awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013), and has been selected to the All‑NBA First Team 17 times. He is also a prolific scorer, rebounder, and playmaker, known for his versatility and basketball IQ.

Beyond the court, LeBron is a philanthropist and activist. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the I PROMISE School, a public school in his hometown of Akron for at-risk children. He has also been involved in political advocacy, notably supporting voting rights and social justice causes. In business, he has diversified into entertainment, owning a stake in the production company SpringHill Entertainment and partnering with major brands such as Nike, Beats by Dre, and Blaze Pizza.
